footer.headline: One clear, powerful system for learning English with AI
footer.description: Daily practice modules, AI study planning and live classes with Bilal Hoca, all in one place.
footer.note: We combine Bilal Hoca's teaching and exam experience with the speed of AI in a single learning flow.
footer.slogan: Bilal Hoca's experience × the power of AI

login.title: Log in and pick up right where you left off
login.intro: Sign in to your Bilal Hoca account to get back to your AI study plan, live classes and progress dashboard.
login.secureText: Sign in with your email and password to go straight to your dashboard.
login.resumeText: Your tasks, live class access and plan status are waiting.
login.afterPurchaseText: If you bought a plan, your password was emailed to you automatically. Use it to log in.
login.formIntro: Sign in securely with your email and password. You'll be taken to your dashboard afterwards.
login.invalidCredentials: Incorrect email or password. Please try again.
login.sessionText: After signing in you'll go straight to your student dashboard.
